title: Vishnu Dharmam - 03 - Bhakti
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt:
In our previous entry, we saw the concepts of a Mantra, Matrakavacham, Mantrasiddhi, and Mantrabalam. Now we shall see one of the more abstract concepts of our Sanathana Dharma, which is Bhakti.

Shounaka Maharishi tells Shathaneeka the story of a conversation between his ancestor Yudhishthira and Lord Shri Krishna. In this conversation, Yudhishtira had just become the ruler of Indraprastha and questions the Lord as to how one can find Bhakti and devotion in the Lord. It is this very question
